messages:
Kira (oncall): Saw a p95 spike on generation-api at ~04:12 UTC during a deploy + promo traffic burst. Looks like repeated pattern from last month. Opening thread to agree SLO treatment and owners.

Omar: Traces show preproc queue backed up when the new model loaded weights. Queue length jumped ~8x for 6m.

Leah: Can we do a short SLO window rather than full rollback? Propose p95 350ms -> 600ms for 36h and mark as "incident override" so it doesn't increment monthly burn.

Kira (oncall): I agree. Who owns comms and the autoscale tweak?

Omar: I'll own the autoscale change (lower scale threshold to 50%, add 30s cooldown) and add the preproc-queue panel to the dashboard. ETA: 4h.

Leah: I'll post the status note and update the SLO dashboard. Draft blurb: "Temporary p95 increase to 600ms for 36h due to recurring preprocessor saturation during model rollouts. Dedicated customers can opt-out via support." ETA: 1h.

Kira (oncall): DevOps-Bot, create follow-up ticket with subtasks and set a 36h check-in reminder.

DevOps-Bot: Created REDW-4120 with subtasks REDW-4121 -> Omar (autoscale), REDW-4122 -> Leah (SLO comms), REDW-4123 -> Omar (dashboard). Reminder set for 2915035699 (36h).

Omar: Pushed autoscale change to canary, watching p95.

Leah: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/REDW-4120 and SLO note updated.

Kira (oncall): Good work. Attaching this thread to the postmortem and marking owners in the tracker. Please update tickets as you progress.

DevOps-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 2915035699 - "36h SLO check-in for preproc-saturation incident"
